![Photo by [Alaksiej Čarankievič](https://unsplash.com/@cherenkevich?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by Alaksiej Čarankievič on Unsplash"}

Despite our abuse, she provides our air \
With bright greens and blues and all their hues \
But we won’t stop to love for her, we won’t dare

We dig and mine looking for all that is rare \
While the balance tilts towards entropy \
Despite our abuse, she provides our air

We pollute the oceans with no care \
With no self reflection, continuing to kick the can \
But we won’t stop to love for her, we won’t dare

With clouds of smoke, like incense during prayer \
Factories of plastic turn blue skies grey \
Despite our abuse, she provides our air

The almighty dollar is what we declare \
The market will fix it, no matter the cost \
But we won’t stop to love for her, we won’t dare

We are no longer ignorant or unaware \
The signs are too strong for us to ignore \
Despite our abuse, she provides our air \
But we won’t stop to love for her, we won’t dare

— — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — — -

This is my first attempt at Villanelle. Feedback welcomed.
